cases.name: a USB folder dropped on another USB window is copied as a tree: CREATE_DIR for it and its subfolder, every file copied and compared, the source unchanged, and both windows listed again
a folder whose name exists on the target is refused (FILE_STAT finds it) over the progress window; nothing is made
a folder dropped on a window showing that folder is refused: it cannot be copied into itself
Esc during a folder copy stops it before the next entry; the folder made so far stays, is said to, and is listed
Move of a folder: the tree is copied and compared, then the source's files and subfolders are deleted deepest first and the emptied folder last
a folder dropped on a drive icon is refused before anything is opened or made
